mechanicalPrinciples.rollType: Use the Force for ordinary Powers and Regimens, except Techniques/Secrets are overlays (no independent roll), and Form Powers may contain lightsaber attack or incoming-attack comparisons.
mechanicalPrinciples.tierSelection: Greatest printed DC met; only qualifying tier. Certain powers require additional defense comparison and combat outcome.
powerRecovery: Normal Form Power and ordinary Power share Force Training suite; source secret/regimen temporary powers carry their own nonrecoverable flag when printed.
mechanicalPrinciples.modifierApplication: Apply each published Form Power rider when the character knows the matching form talent and the base Form Power is legally activated. A persistent activeLightsaberForm stance is NOT a rider prerequisite; retain independent form stance effects only where their own source requires them.
mechanicalPrinciples.errataPriority: Official source errata when independently certified > printed PDF > TXT transcription > old compendium data
